title: Turn a custom idea into a reviewable specification
intro: A bespoke concept becomes reviewable when its function, envelope, material and verification are explicit. Build a brief, compare alternatives on shared criteria and define what a prototype must resolve.

sections.title: Translate wishes into requirements
sections.text: Record the user, stored contents, movement, site envelope and delivery route. Separate surveyed dimensions from proposals and missing information. Give every requirement an acceptance observation: opening a door, retrieving an item or matching a finish sample. Revisit these links when appearance changes so that function and scope do not drift silently.
sections.caption: Requirement, evidence and open information remain distinct.

sections.title: Compare alternatives on equal terms
sections.text: Compare rectilinear and curved options against the same storage and delivery needs. Record consequences for parts, edges, support and service access. Reject failure of essential requirements before aesthetic scoring. Changing a surface finish is not equivalent to changing the carcass: a new construction form reopens relevant fabrication and connection details.
sections.caption: Shared requirements expose different construction consequences.

sections.title: Define the prototype question
sections.text: Define the prototype question, scale, material and limits. A volume mock-up may show reach and collisions but does not establish the strength of the final connection. Record the observation, affected requirement, revision and reviewer. Prototype acceptance applies to the question actually tested, not every untested aspect of the product.
sections.caption: State what the prototype did and did not establish.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: Changing a straight front to a curved one causes a drawer collision in the mock-up. Revisit movement and detailing before polishing the rendering; the failed requirement is functional access, not colour.
example.decision: Decision: resolve drawer movement before accepting the form.

quiz.question: Does a successful cardboard volume model prove joint strength?
quiz.explanation: The tested question and material limit the conclusion.

assignment.prompt: Submit a bespoke brief, two comparable options and a focused prototype plan.

faq.question: Can an image start the brief?
faq.answer: Yes, as inspiration; then define function, constraints and evidence.
